host.description: Fully qualified host name of the OpenBao API and web UI, like 'vault.example.org'

http2https.title: HTTP to HTTPS redirection
http2https.description: Redirect all HTTP requests to HTTPS. Defaults to true

lets_encrypt.title: Let's Encrypt certificate
lets_encrypt.description: Request a valid Let's Encrypt certificate for the host name

log_level.title: Server log level
log_level.description: OpenBao server log level. Defaults to the current value, initially 'info'

audit_log.title: Audit log
audit_log.description: Send the OpenBao audit log to the systemd journal. Defaults to the current value, initially false

unseal_mode.title: Unseal mode
unseal_mode.description: 'manual': Shamir unseal keys must be provided after every restart. 'auto': a static key stored on the node unseals OpenBao automatically. 'transit': an external OpenBao or Vault Transit engine unseals it (store its token first with openbao-transit-token). It can be changed only before OpenBao is initialized. Defaults to the current value, initially 'manual'

user_domain.title: User domain
user_domain.description: NethServer 8 user domain (LDAP or Active Directory) used for OpenBao directory login. Empty string disables it. Defaults to the current value

ldap_admin_group.title: Administrators group
ldap_admin_group.description: Group of user_domain whose members get full administrative access to OpenBao. Required when user_domain is set

auto_initialize.title: Automatic initialization
auto_initialize.description: Let OpenBao initialize itself with directory login already configured: no root token or recovery keys are generated. Requires unseal_mode 'auto', user_domain and ldap_admin_group. It has no effect once OpenBao is initialized

notify_recipients.title: Notification recipients
notify_recipients.description: Email addresses notified when OpenBao is down or sealed. The cluster SMTP smarthost is used. Empty list disables the notifications

ip_allowlist.title: Allowed networks
ip_allowlist.description: Client IP addresses or networks (CIDR) allowed to reach the OpenBao API and web UI through Traefik. Empty list: no restriction

ldap_group_policies.title: Group policies
ldap_group_policies.description: Additional directory groups mapped to OpenBao policies, applied by self-initialization or by openbao-apply-config

starter_kits.title: Starter kits
starter_kits.description: Components prepared by self-initialization or by openbao-apply-config: 'kv' key/value v2 store at secret/, 'pki' internal certificate authority at pki/, 'approle' application login

vpn_api.title: Cluster network API
vpn_api.description: Also publish the OpenBao API on the node cluster VPN address (third module TCP port), for NethServer modules and services of the cluster

transit_address.description: Transit seal: URL of the external OpenBao or Vault, like https://vault.example.org:8200

transit_mount.description: Transit seal: mount path of the transit engine. Default 'transit'

transit_key.description: Transit seal: name of the transit key

transit_tls_skip_verify.description: Transit seal: do not verify the TLS certificate of the external server

public_access.title: Public access
public_access.description: Publish the API and web UI through Traefik on the host name. false: reachable only on the cluster network API (requires vpn_api). Default true

snapshot_keep.description: Number of daily Raft snapshots kept on the node (requires the module token). 0 disables them

ha_role.title: High availability role
ha_role.description: Experimental. 'standalone' (default): a single-node OpenBao. 'primary': accept other OpenBao instances as members of its Raft cluster; it publishes the Raft cluster port and the cluster network API on the node VPN address and requires manual or Transit unseal. 'member': join the Raft cluster of the instance named by ha_join; allowed only before this instance is initialized, and it takes the seal of that cluster.

ha_join.title: Instance to join
ha_join.description: Module ID of an OpenBao instance that accepts members (see ha_candidates of get-configuration). Required with ha_role 'member'.
